description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Currency' which formats data values as currency strings, extending a formatted data preprocessor. It includes configuration for currency symbols and inherits formatting behavior from its parent class.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Currency
classes.description: A data preprocessor class that formats numerical data as currency strings, e.g., '$10.00', extending the formatted data preprocessor.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Currency
methods.description: Constructor method accepting a currency symbol to format subsequent data values according to the specified currency.
